ideas.title: Cells, membranes and microscopy
ideas.mechanism: Life is cellular; organelles and magnification/resolution set what can be seen and what a cell can do.

ideas.title: Biological molecules
ideas.mechanism: Monomer chemistry (carbs, lipids, proteins, water) determines polymer function.

ideas.title: Genetics, DNA and inheritance
ideas.mechanism: Nucleic-acid sequence is replicated, expressed and transmitted; alleles segregate in meiosis.

ideas.title: Exchange and transport systems
ideas.mechanism: Surface-area and mass-flow systems move gases, water and solutes in plants and animals.

ideas.title: Bioenergetics: respiration and photosynthesis
ideas.mechanism: Redox pathways capture or release free energy, coupling to ATP.

ideas.title: Coordination and homeostasis
ideas.mechanism: Neural and endocrine signals plus negative feedback keep internal conditions in range.

ideas.title: Reproduction, development and life cycles
ideas.mechanism: Sexual and asexual cycles produce the next generation; development maps organs onto that cycle.

ideas.title: Ecology, evolution and biodiversity
ideas.mechanism: Energy flow and selection acting on variation produce populations, communities and biodiversity patterns.

ideas.title: Membranes and transport into/out of cells
ideas.mechanism: The fluid mosaic bilayer sets permeability; diffusion, osmosis and active transport move solutes.

ideas.title: Enzymes
ideas.mechanism: A protein active site lowers activation energy; temperature, pH and inhibitors change rate.

ideas.title: DNA replication, protein synthesis and mutation
ideas.mechanism: Base pairing templates replication and translation; substitution/indel can change the polypeptide.

ideas.title: ATP and cellular energy currency
ideas.mechanism: ATP couples exergonic respiration/photosynthesis to endergonic work; cells are not powered by glucose directly.

ideas.title: Immunity
ideas.mechanism: Antigen recognition, antibodies and vaccination distinguish self from pathogen.

ideas.title: Nutrient cycles and energy flow
ideas.mechanism: Energy flows one way; matter cycles (C, N) between biotic and abiotic stores.

ideas.title: Disease and pathogens
ideas.mechanism: Pathogens cause infectious disease; transmission and antibiotics sit beside the physiology spine.

ideas.title: Biotechnology and genetic engineering
ideas.mechanism: Enzymes, vectors and culture systems make useful products or modified organisms.

ideas.title: Human health, diet and drugs
ideas.mechanism: Diet, lifestyle and drugs alter health beside the core physiology pathway.

ideas.title: Classification and taxonomy
ideas.mechanism: Shared features and binomial names group organisms (chem B1 nomenclature analogue).

ideas.title: Conservation and human impacts
ideas.mechanism: Habitat destruction, pollution, climate and conservation actions sit beside ecology theory.

ideas.title: Practical and data skills
ideas.mechanism: Reagents, eyepiece graticules and rate measurements are experimental skills beside content nodes.
